title: Umona Owawudlayo
intro: Ibali elidala kunalo naliphi na ubukumkani okanye isibhalo—intlekele yokuqala yomntu ezelwe ngumona. Omnye umntu, omdala kubantwana ababini abazelwe ngabazali bokuqala, wabukela ngomsindo njengoko umntakwabo omncinci efumana uncedo olwaliwayo. Okwalandela yayikukukhetha okubi kakhulu, eshiya igazi lokuqala elakha lachithwa emhlabeni. Ungatyhila ubuwena, uvavanyo, kunye nokuzisola okukrakra?
clues: Ndakha ndenza umnikelo kuAllah, kodwa awuzange wamkelwe kum.
Umnikelo womntakwethu wam wamkelwa, ngelixa owam walahlwa—into endandingenakuyinyamezela.
Ndaba ngowokuqala ukubulala emhlabeni, ndibulala umntakwethu.
UAllah wathumela isidalwa somhlaba—intaka emnyama eyayimba emhlabeni—ukuze indifundise indlela yokufihla into endiyenzileyo, ndaza ndasala ndizisola kuphela.

outcome.label: Isiphumo

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
